title: "Control modifiers: Docking"
description: "Modifiers that only the controls in the Docking area have."
sidebar:
  label: "Docking"
---

Modifiers are extension methods that return a changed copy of the element, so you can chain them.

**Learn more:** [Docking Windows](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/docking)

## `ActiveContentChanged` [#activecontentchanged]

Wires the active-content-changed handler. Passing `null` clears.

```csharp
DockManager ActiveContentChanged(this DockManager el, Action<DockActiveContentChangedEventArgs>? handler)
```

Declared in `DockManagerEventExtensions` (package `Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Advanced`, `using Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Docking;`).

**Applies to:** [`DockManager`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/elements/docking#dockmanager).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `handler` | `Action<DockActiveContentChangedEventArgs>?` |  |
